summary: Iter85: Tested GDPR social-feature consent end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (GET/PUT /api/account/feature-consent grant+withdraw+401, /api/admin/featured-clips admin-only 403/401, seeded reports listed with correct full_report_ready flags, withdrawal on user removes both reports from admin list). Frontend: Dashboard feature-consent-card renders, toggle flips aria-checked false↔true, 'Featured: ON' status badge appears when ON, state persists after page reload. Admin Marketing tab shows seeded full + preview rows with 'Clip ready'/'Preview only' badges, download btn disabled ONLY for preview, /report/{id} link correct. Privacy page has all sections 1–12 including new '9. Social media features (optional consent)' with withdrawal + parent/under-18 wording, no duplicates, no spurious 13. Regression cards (referral-invite, profile-visibility) render fine. Upload consent card presence verified by code (data-testid grep) — could not exercise UI because the card only renders after step 2 (player lock) which requires real object detection; a 320x240 green ffmpeg dummy cannot be locked. Cleanup: temp user + 2 reports deleted, admin feature_consent reset to withdrawn.

FEATURE_CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION constant is used consistently (backend upload path + PUT endpoint). Frontend intentionally does not verify version string; if versioning ever changes, add a UI banner prompting re-consent.
server.py file is 14,700 lines — significantly above 700-line guideline; consider modularization (already flagged in prior iterations).

rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in this feature. Prior false negative in an early script was due to case-sensitive check for 'FEATURED: ON' text while actual DOM text is 'Featured: ON'; corrected by asserting on aria-checked attribute of the toggle.
